clauses.scope_note: The repository contents are stated to be published for personal distribution, reference, and installation of the included skill files. The text does not expressly grant copying, modification, sublicensing, or other uses under this statement.
clauses.condition_explanation: The stated purpose must be personal distribution, reference, or installation of the included skill files.

clauses.clause_label: No license for other purposes without written permission
clauses.scope_note: Applies to the contents of this repository. The prohibition is limited to the stated activities for purposes outside those identified in the preceding sentence; written permission is an exception.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the purpose is outside personal distribution, reference, or installation of the included skill files and the copyright holder has not given written permission.

coverage_notes: Lines 1–6 were reviewed. The text does not grant other activities or address modified artifacts, derivatives, combined products, commercial use, network services, source provision, training, fees, or data and output rights.
The statement identifies permitted purposes but does not specify the scope or mechanics of any permission to carry them out; no broader license terms are supplied.
